title: 동네 공공시설 이용하기: 어디에서 무엇을 해요?
objective: By the end, you can name common public places in Korea and say what you do there in short sentences, such as sending a parcel, borrowing a book, or signing up for a class.
summary: Learn 10 everyday words for using public places in your neighborhood, such as the community service center, hospital, post office, library, and bank.

task.title: Use the place words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, or write the Korean word or sentence that fits.

words.meaning: community service center (local office for residents)
words.exampleMeaning: When you move, you have to go to the community service center.
Get off the bus in front of the hospital.
I sent a letter home from the post office.
I'd like to send this parcel to the U.S.
On weekends, I study at the library.
I borrowed three books from the library.
I went to the bank and withdrew money.

words.meaning: facilities (the building, rooms, and equipment of a place)
words.exampleMeaning: This library's facilities are clean and nice.
Many people use the bank at lunchtime.

words.meaning: to sign up for, to apply for
words.exampleMeaning: I signed up for a Korean class at the community service center.

exercises: Choose the right place: ① 책을 빌리고 싶어요. 어디에 가요? (도서관 / 은행) ② 소포를 보내고 싶어요. 어디에 가요? (우체국 / 병원)
Fill in the blank with 빌리다, 신청하다, or 이용하다 in the -았/었어요 form: ① 어제 친구한테 우산을 ____. ② 다음 달 수영 수업을 ____. ③ 오늘 처음 병원 주차장을 ____.
Fill in the blank with 시설, 소포, or 병원: ① 우리 동네 체육관은 ____이 아주 좋아요. ② 어제 보낸 ____가 오늘 도착했어요. ③ ____에 가려면 이 버스를 타세요.
Answer Yes or No: ① 은행에서 돈을 찾을 수 있어요. ② 우체국에서 책을 빌려요. ③ 도서관에서 소포를 보내요. ④ 주민센터는 공공시설이에요.
Answer in Korean with one sentence. You went to the post office yesterday and sent a parcel: 어제 어디에서 뭐 했어요?
answers: ① 빌렸어요 ② 신청했어요 ③ 이용했어요
① 시설 ② 소포 ③ 병원
① Yes ② No ③ No ④ Yes
어제 우체국에서 소포를 보냈어요. (어제 우체국에 가서 소포를 보냈어요.)
